[[File:Fake_ID.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Wookiee offering a forged identichip]]
'''Forgers''' and '''counterfeiters''' were individuals who would forge documents and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in order to generate profit. Some forgers also carried [[forgery kit]]s, which were [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kits]], made to make counterfeiting easier.
